hold_text: Manager review of #15002 asked for this as a Tier-2 hold: the dry round trip now reads the linked symbol click-free before the walk and re-selects and verifies it on every exit. It touches the prop executor's dry path and adds one adapter reader; the manager reviews and merges.
why: After a successful dry walk place_bracket leaves the terminal linked to the walked symbol (ETHUSD) and nothing restored SOLUSD, so the next SOL ticket depended on a switch click. Armed paths are unchanged; the restore uses the existing gated, verified select_linked_symbol.
